description: After the identity is confirmed, `client identity` and `client list` still return `suggestedIdentity` with the machine's Git name and email (a different person here), next to the confirmed identity.
expected: suggestedIdentity is omitted once an identity exists.
actual: Both identity and suggestedIdentity in every session payload.
suggested_fix: Return suggestedIdentity only while identity is null.
